name: Add Dashboard View
description: Adds a new view to the impulse dashboard. Defines the shape to render and generates the renderer code.

variables.name: shape_name
variables.description: The impulse shape this view renders (e.g., 'trace_list', 'activity_metrics')

variables.name: view_title
variables.description: Human-readable title for the dashboard card

variables.name: data_fields
variables.description: Comma-separated list of fields to display from the shape data

tasks.description: Design the renderer function for this shape

prompt.template:
Design a renderer for the {{shape_name}} impulse shape. View Title: {{view_title}} Fields to display: {{data_fields}} Create a JavaScript function that: 1. Takes the shape data as input 2. Returns HTML string for rendering 3. Handles missing/null fields gracefully 4. Uses the existing dashboard CSS classes: - .impulse-card (container) - .metric / .metric-value / .metric-label (for numbers) - .data-list (for lists) - .shape-badge (for shape type indicator) Output the renderer function to add to shapeRenderers: ```javascript {{shape_name}}: (data) => `

{{view_title}} {{shape_name}}

// ... render fields
` ``` Save to: /tmp/dashboard/new-renderer.js

tasks.description: Create activity that sources data for this view
